status: 길잃은새, 2022년 10월 이후 처음 기록되어 2024년 목록에 오름
summary: 2023년 3월 5일 제주 서귀포항에서 국내 처음 기록된 길잃은새로, 괭이갈매기 무리에 섞여 3월 12일까지 머물며 수산물 유통센터 앞에서 생선 찌꺼기를 먹었다. 중앙아시아 고원의 해발 3,000m가 넘는 호숫가에서 무리 지어 번식하고, 겨울에는 인도·스리랑카에서 동남아시아, 중국 남서부에 이르는 해안과 큰 강, 호수로 내려간다. 같은 해 봄에는 일본 도쿄와 중국 동부에서도 거의 같은 때에 기록되었다.

art.subject: Brown-headed Gull (Larus brunnicephalus), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as on the Korean coast in autumn: head white with a dark grey-brown spot behind the eye and a faint grey wash over the crown; mantle and wing coverts pale grey; folded wingtip black with a small white mirror near the tip of the outermost primaries; underparts, rump and tail white. Bill red with a dark tip, deeper and longer than Black-headed Gull's; iris pale whitish-yellow with a thin red orbital ring; legs red.
art.pose: standing at the water's edge on wet mud, side view, wings folded
art.scene: Korean estuary mudflat in October among Black-headed Gulls, soft overcast autumn light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in winter plumage, side view standing on wet mud: white head with a dark ear patch, pale iris, red bill deeper than a Black-headed Gull's with a dark tip, pale grey mantle and wing coverts, black folded wingtip with a white mirror, white tail, red legs

adult in winter plumage in flight seen squarely from above: head, body and tail in one line, wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span and bent slightly at the wrist, pale grey upperwing, black wingtip with two large white mirrors on the outer primaries, white tail

adult in flight seen squarely from below: head, body and tail in one line, wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span and bent slightly at the wrist, grey underwing with largely black primaries and white mirrors near the tip, white body and tail, red bill, red feet tucked under the tail
art.build: Medium-sized hooded gull, noticeably larger and bulkier than Black-headed Gull and smaller than Black-tailed Gull; rounded head with a gently sloping forehead. Bill fairly stout, longer and deeper than Black-headed Gull's, with a slight droop at the tip. Legs medium length, red. At rest the black wingtips project well beyond the tail. In flight the outer wing has a broad black tip enclosing large white mirrors on the outermost two primaries, set off by a white wedge across the bases of the outer primaries; from below the primaries look largely black. Tail square, white. In breeding plumage (spring to summer) it wears a pale brown hood, darker at the rear edge.
avoid: Do not paint Black-headed Gull's wingtip (white outer primaries with only narrow black tips); the Brown-headed Gull has a broad black wingtip with white mirrors.
Do not give the adult a dark iris; its eye is pale.
Do not paint a brown hood on this autumn bird; the hood is breeding plumage only.
Do not paint a thin, short bill or pink legs.
